violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: Sticky rice, coconut milk pudding, milk foam flavors observed without date marking.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. Pic added dates to prepared food items.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: Clean containers and pitcher on equipment rack
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. Corrected through instruction. OCHA THAI KITCHEN AND CAFE (Inspection Date: 03/05/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: pre-packaged roast duck (leg & thigh) 47F, purple yam (ube) cheesecake 43F; rehydrated noodles 58 (~1hr)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM removed items from facility and will not be served to the public. Noodles were moved to RIC.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: shelving and work counters, ice machine
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Remove unused items and thoroughly clean facility and equipment.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Air Gap Provided
violations.observation: Observed a hose attached to a faucet fixture. The hose extended below the flood rim level of the sink basin.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by providing an air gap as specified under 5-202.13.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the walls in the kitchen, overhead vents in kitchen and surfaces under shelving and equipment are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Remove unused items and thoroughly clean facility and equipment.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the lights out under the hood, walls with holes and missing tile grout is not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.

violations.title: Premises Free of Unnecessary Items/Equipment
violations.observation: Observed that items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment are being stored on the premises.
violations.corrective_action: Remove unnecessary items, including equipment which is no longer in use, from the premises to allow for regular and effective cleaning and to prevent harborage conditions. Remove unused items and thoroughly clean facility and equipment.

violations.title: Cooking Raw Animal Foods, Minimum of 155F
violations.observation: The following comminuted or ground meat, fish, or game animal was not cooked to a sufficient temperature and/or time to eliminate pathogenic bacteria: Cooked beef observed with pink streaking indicating meat was not fully cooked.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods such as ratites, injected meats, comminuted meats, commercially raised game animals, and raw eggs not for immediate consumption shall be cooked to a minimum internal temperature of 155F for at least 15 seconds. EHS instructed manager to train employees to check cooking temperature of meats. Beef taken to wok to fully cook.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marking: curries for fried rice, sticky rice, milk caps for drinks
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers for seafood were observed reused for the storage of Flour breading mixture for fried chicken.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. Discussed container usage with PIC.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: Side of fryer unit observed with accumulation of grease, Storage table for oils and sauces observed lined with cardboard and foil in poor repair
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: Knives in preparation area observed with food bits and debris on magnetic knife holder. EHS discussed storage shelving in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. Clean and sanitize all food contact materials before use.

violations.title: Cooking Raw Animal Foods, Minimum of 165F
violations.observation: The following poultry item was not cooked to a sufficient temperature and/or time to eliminate pathogenic bacteria: Chicken boiled on range observed at 152F.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods such as poultry, wild game animals, stuffed fish, stuffed meat, stuffed pasta, stuffed poultry, stuffed ratites, or stuffing containing any of these raw animal foods shall be cooked to a minimum internal temperature of 165F for at least 15 seconds. EHS instructed employee to return chicken to boil to a temperature of 165F. Chicken cooked to 172F. PIC demonstrated to employees with a food thermometer to check cooking temperatures.
